title: Uncached template fragment rendering
summary: Frequently rendered Flask templates recompute stable fragments on every request.
rationale: Repeated template rendering and helper calls can create avoidable CPU cost for pages with shared navigation, summaries, or dashboards.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Cache stable fragments or precompute view models with clear invalidation boundaries.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
